Subject: Pilot economics & next steps (post-demo)

Hi Ava — great demo earlier, thanks for walking us through BrightLayer’s ingestion and summarization flows. Quick recap and suggested next steps on the economics side so we can size a short pilot top-up and avoid mid-trial throttles: 

Summary from our call:
- Expected inference traffic: ~1.2M generated tokens/day (aggregate), ~36M/month (peak expectation).
- Typical prompt lengths: 120–220 tokens; responses 150–400 tokens per call (varying by workflow).
- Critical latency SLO for the UI flow: 400–600ms p95; some batch jobs tolerate higher latency.

Pricing/target: you mentioned a target range of $8–$15 per 1M tokens depending on latency and features. For planning I modeled a target of $12/1M tokens as a middle ground; attached is a quick unit-cost calc showing cost at $8, $12, and $15.

Proposal / asks:
1) To keep the pilot healthy, we can provide a contingency credit top-up of $2,000 (equivalent token allowance attached) while we finalize a short mutual action plan.
2) Can you confirm if the ~36M/month figure is a sustained run-rate or a peak? If sustained, we should discuss a committed monthly band to get unit economics closer to $8–10/1M.
3) Please share the procurement contact and any PO timing — I’ll loop in Rishi (finance) and Marissa (CS) to expedite approvals.

Attachments: redwood_unit_cost_calc.xlsx (simple per-token model). I’ll draft a one-page MAP for signoff once you confirm the volume band.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

---
Note: trying to keep the pilot funded while we finalize the pricing band — open to adjusting the top-up size if you expect a larger burst next week.

- Budget guidance: we’re targeting $8–12/1M tokens for gen-heavy workflows that need sub-600ms p95; for offline / async pipelines we can tolerate higher $/1M.

Please include a clear statement of what the $2,000 top-up buys (token count + expiration) and a simple MAP with milestones and expected telemetry we'll share with our engineering leads.
